The '''Cluckeroo''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Critters|Tataris]]. It evolves from [[Clucky]] at 3 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Cluckeroo doesn't bother with aiming. Somehow, wounded allies and unlucky enemies end up exactly where they need to be."

Cluckeroo is an evolved from of Clucky, one of your starting Tataris.

==Appearance==
Cluckeroo is a chubby white and green chicken holding up a tannish-brown nest like a pair of pants. It has a 4-leaf clover on its head, a red beak and stubby red legs, green wings and a short green tail.

=== Design Theme ===
Cluckeroo’s design is themed around luck, most evidently by its four leaf clover. Additionally, its in-game description reflects this by stating that Cluckeroo “doesn’t bother aiming.” Older descriptions suggest a pastoral theme, with the Tatari Observation Diary saying it loves taking relaxing sunbaths, a trait that matches its cozy-farm appearance.

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'[[Clucky]]s must grow clovers to evolve, but nobody knows where the unlucky ones go.' - Clucky Handbook"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26, its bio description said: "Only those with sprouts that grow into four-leaf clovers can evolve. A relaxing sunbath is one of Cluckeroo's favorite pastimes."

==Strategy==
[[File:Cluckeroo Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Cluckeroo's attack range]]
Cluckeroo is an early game grass type healer, alongside [[Capypapa]]. Since it also does damage, it can be a better grass healer than [[Buddi]], until the latter evolves into [[Solaflora]].
